quest.title: A Flower that Blooms Across the Sky
quest.description: Avin doesn't want to forget her Aranara friend, so you resolve to help her recover the wonderful memories of her past. The Aranara you summoned is also happy to lend a hand...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x625, Primogem x60, Mora x38100, Guide to Transience x5, Unknown Item #363349 x1, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

talks.objective: Go to the Mawtiyima Forest with Arapurva

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, Paimon's been meaning to ask what you meant by "prepared."

dialogues.speaker: Arapurva
dialogues.text: Nara Avin has not completely remembered. Memories and dreams are both necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Dreams...

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: But I'll never be able to stand again. Even if I can recover, I don't know how long that'll take.

dialogues.speaker: Arapurva
dialogues.text: Such worries are not needed here. Nara Avin, you must remember. Dreams are connected to your heart, not your body.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: My heart...?

dialogues.speaker: Arapurva
dialogues.text: I led you this far, but now Nara Avin must find her precious things by herself.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Huh? He's gone, just like that?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: It looks like the sky here has changed somewhat.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: My heart...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: I... stood up.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: It wasn't hard at all, and it didn't feel weird. It was like... how things were before I got sick.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so that means we're...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're inside a dream.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not our first time in one. Ah, no wonder Arapurva said not to worry... Avin can move freely in this dream.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Wow, that's amazing, is this... the power of my heart?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: How amazing! Now we can all look for Arashani together.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's race! Lemme see how good you really are!

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: I might not have recovered yet...

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Whatever, let's go! I won't lose, not even to an adult!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, and off she goes!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, this was easy. Paimon thought she'd need more time.

choices.text: I guess that's what they call aptitude.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, that's true. Let's catch up with them.

choices.text: That's the power of a wish.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: *pants* You're... good...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hehe, if we had run any further, you would've caught up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Avin was neck and neck with Yoimiya!

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: I've outrun lots of adults before. Long legs don't necessarily mean you run faster. Training's important, too.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Haha, I won't even be able to compete with you in a few years.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hm, let's see... Where should we go next?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, look! Something's floating up ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It looks like a... star?

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Does it want us to follow it?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hmm, maybe. Let's follow it.

talks.objective: Catch up to the drifting star

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is our destination? But Paimon doesn't see an Aranara. Just this big stone.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: I'm so happy... I almost forgot how it feels to be this happy...

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: You know, at first, it felt like my world had shrunk down to a tiny space.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: But as long as I continue moving forward, new sights will always appear in front of me, and my world will keep expanding before my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Even though I don't know how I did it, I know I have you all to thank.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh, that's not important. What's important is that you've remembered the joy of going through the world.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Our memories don't just symbolize our past. They can also shine a light on our future.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Once you find the hope in your heart again, that happiness will come back to you.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Yes! Thank you, Yoimiya! Thank you all!

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Let's keep looking for Arashani. It doesn't look like he's here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... Uh, then why would the star lead us here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This stone really stands out.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: I dunno how to explain this... I don't know what it is, but it feels very familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Almost like it's a part of me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I know!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Could this stone be your Urstone?

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Ur—Urstone?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: It's a very rare ore that symbolizes a person's aspirations and dreams.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Since you can see it, that means you've found what you've lost.

response.speaker: Avin
response.text: Is that how it works...?

response.speaker: Avin
response.text: It's just like in fairy tales... I thought I'd stopped believing in those.

response.speaker: Avin
response.text: But I'm glad that I found that belief again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Th—They passed right through!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Let's go after them!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Yoimiya! HEY! ...Well, we have no choice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We passed through, but nothing seems to have changed.

response.speaker: Arashani
response.text: It has been a while, Nara Avin. It really has been a while, yes?

response.speaker: Avin
response.text: Arashani...

response.speaker: Arashani
response.text: Why do you look sad? Oh. Arashani knows. You are happy.

response.speaker: Avin
response.text: Arashani! *sobs*

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Aw, the Aranara sure have a flair for magical journeys.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: They not only helped Avin find her best friend, but they also showed us what an Urstone is.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, um, we have to look for one of our own later — to make the purest lens.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! It's kinda funny, but Paimon thinks we can actually do it.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But we have to bring her back to Sumeru City first. Her mother must be worried sick.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: It... The dream ended.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: We dreamed a most lovely dream.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Don't look so lonely! He's right next to you.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Arashani! Y—You're... still here...

dialogues.speaker: Arashani
dialogues.text: Arashani wants to say sorry. It is not that Arashani did not want to find Nara. Arashani could not remember the time.

dialogues.speaker: Arashani
dialogues.text: Arashani does not dare enter the city. Arashani did not see Nara Avin, so Arashani thought you had made new friends.

dialogues.speaker: Arapurva
dialogues.text: That is normal and unavoidable. It is not something to be grieved.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: It's okay, I understand. This happened because I lost sight of myself.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: But I think I understand now. Yoimiya's right. Everyone gets bad luck, but we have to support each other through unlucky times.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Thanks for helping me rediscover my memories and dreams. I won't let your work go to waste.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hehe. You've also helped us a lot, so don't be so humble! To be honest, we didn't know where to start with the Urstone.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: But now that we're on this track, I think we'll find it easy!

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Yoimiya, you need this Urstone because you want to see a meteor shower?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Yep. Oh! Once we find it, you should come with us!

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: If that's how things are...

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: I'm happy to lend you my Urstone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What just happened? Did you just take... glasses out of your chest?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have no idea what's going on, either.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hahaha, how'd you know we'd need this?

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: I didn't. I just thought that since you helped me find my precious friend, I should help you using something precious to me...

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: And then the light turned into this. Is this what you needed?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Thank you. I didn't expect us to solve our problem like this. Alright, time to give it a go!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Not that I know how to use it, but let's see what my intuition says.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Where are you... Where are you...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Ooh! I think I see it! Oh, uh... It was pretty obvious.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: C'mon, I'll lead the way. Once we're done watching the meteor shower, I'll accompany you home.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Also, thank you for helping us. Actually, let me scrap the pleasantries and give you a heartfelt compliment instead!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: You all are great storytellers!

dialogues.speaker: Arapurva
dialogues.text: Oh, what a coincidence. I would say the same for you, Red Nara.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mmm... Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're waking up already? But Paimon wants to watch more...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: The meteors we summoned flew up from the ground...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: They were exactly like fireworks!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Ah, I could've kept watching that forever. That was the realest, grandest, most magical dream I've ever had!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon too! Paimon didn't expect you to just pull us onto that shooting star, though.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hehe~ Honestly, I didn't think about it at all. I just thought it'd be a shame if we didn't try something crazy.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: You know me. It really doesn't matter to me if our experience was real or a dream.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I really should thank you two, though. You set all this up as a backup plan because you knew that meteor showers are hard to catch, right?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Don't worry, I loved it so so so much! I think this ranks as the absolute best gift I've ever been given.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh phew, that's good. Paimon was afraid that you might be angry after hearing the truth.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Why would I be? I dreamed about helpful, friendly, cute Aranara...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I dreamed that we ran and jumped atop large mushrooms, and we discovered Urstone in a very unexpected way...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: And when I thought we had woken up, the next part was even more amazing!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: From her heart, Avin brought forth Urstone glasses. We found meteors that flew up from the earth, and we even became one with the shooting stars themselves...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: That's right. Dreams themselves may be imaginary, but they're also experiences that can never be relived or replicated.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: If we were sticklers about truth and fiction, we would've missed out on so much beauty and emotion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, you sure know your way with words. Paimon's gonna bump you up a few places on the "Paimon's Best Friends" list!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So there's a leaderboard for that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, by the way... the Aranara, they don't usually like...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh yeah, they're so cute! We really have to thank those lovely carvings.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The wood carvings?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Yeah. If we hadn't seen those wood carvings, then we wouldn't have dreamed of such cute Aranara.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, don't worry, I know. I think they're very cute, and I'm happy to protect them.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Well, it's almost time. Let's send her home.

choices.text: I think they're cuter than the carvings.
Who's to say we've woken up?
You already knew that it was a dream.

talks.objective: Go to Port Ormos for Yoimiya's send-off

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Sumeru's such a nice place. I'll be back for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Niousha
dialogues.text: You will always be welcome here. Avin would be happy to see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: It's a deal! I'll be waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you got it!

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: Yoimiya, before you go back, I want to tell you about my new dream.

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: I want to travel to Inazuma on my own and watch a fireworks show there.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Wow, that's impressive! Hehe, I didn't expect to be introduced to new customers while on vacation.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'll make you some fireworks that you'll never forget!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: You two as well. No matter how busy your adventures get, remember to come back to Inazuma. We'll always welcome you, no matter when you drop by!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: You've got to come and watch the fireworks this meteor shower inspired as they soar high in the sky!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like a plan!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I will, I will! Haha, you're as earnest as ever.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh yeah, by the way, have a look at this.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: An Aranara Carving...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: That's right. This is the one you helped me pick, and you said it looked kinda like me. I went to buy another one — this one's for you.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Look at it whenever you're feeling down. Who knows, maybe it'll raise your spirits. If nothing else, you'll know that I'm supporting you all the way.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Of course, meeting in person is still better, hehe.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Okay, I'll be heading back now. I'm sure we'll meet again soon!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I really loved the trip you prepared for me — in fact, I'm totally impressed!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: No matter where you two go, I know that our friendship and its warmth will support you.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: So go forward — to the end of your journey, and to the ends of this world!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: See you around!

choices.text: May all your days be filled with happiness.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Every day, and forever!

choices.text: Fireworks are for now, but friends are forever!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Wh—Why'd you just shout that out? It's embarrassing...

dialogues.speaker: Avin
dialogues.text: (Yoimiya's fast... I was so close to winning.)

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: (Avin almost caught up to me. She sure is something.)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Losing your way in the dream, you somehow find yourself back at the beginning...
